items.author: Ajay Vishnu Addala, Tableau Ambassador, Senior Consultant at Eigen X, Philadelphia TUG leader, Nov 21
items.summary: Built "Pokédex Arena," an interactive Pokémon explorer and battle-arena Tableau Data App, in under 30 minutes, and published it to the Tableau Community Data Apps Gallery, which he says is now live. [App](https://lnkd.in/e6fYCVWk). 9 reactions.

items.author: Lisa Hitch, MPH, Coaching Data Consultants at The Information Lab, 2x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 21
items.summary: First hours with Tableau Studio: with the same prompt, the Data Apps came out far better than the dashboards, which surprised her as a dashboard builder by trade. 2 reactions, 1 comment.

items.author: Hiroaki Morita, BI Engineering, data analysis, Nov 21
items.summary: His first Tableau Data App: a Superstore sales view with filter pills, KPI cards (sales, profit, margin vs. prior year) and a regional bar chart with prior-year markers. Clean, polished look. 1 reaction, 1 comment.

items.author: Adam "Skillz" Mico, Product Management Director, Tableau Core Skills, Nov 21
items.summary: A Tableau PM is launching "Shipped, Explained," a newsletter that explains newly shipped Tableau features. Issue 1 covers Tableau Studio Skills. Worth subscribing to for Studio and Data Apps how-tos straight from the product team. 19 reactions, 5 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Sandeep Pawar, Principal Program Manager, Fabric IQ at Microsoft Fabric CAT, Nov 19
items.summary: Demo of a Fabric App dashboard (KPI cards, trend line, donut, bars) with a Fabric IQ chat panel that builds visuals on request and respects the slicers. This is Microsoft's conversational-analytics answer to Tableau Data Apps. 164 reactions, 15 comments, 15 reposts.

items.author: Michael John Peña, Technical Advisor, Microsoft MVP & MCT, O'Reilly author, Nov 21
items.summary: Open-source "Semantic Model Explainer" Fabric App that draws a 40-table semantic model as a solar system with health and coverage lenses. He closes with an offer of AI-with-BI consulting, a good example of turning a showcase build into a services pitch. 4 reactions, 1 comment.
